Selected case studies

Five accounts I ran from the plan through to the reporting. Open any one for the challenge, the strategy and the full numbers.

Healthcare

Egypt · 9 campaigns · USD

Al Amal Medical Center

Nine campaigns, one per service line, built to put patient enquiries in the clinic's inbox.

532Patient conversations
$2.28Avg cost per conversation
$0.81Best campaign cost

Challenge

A multi-service clinic competing for local patients against larger hospital brands. Dentistry, wellness, maternity and home care each needed a different audience and a different message. One clinic-wide campaign could not serve all four.

Strategy

Split the account by service line so every service had its own creative, audience and budget. Lead with conversation objectives rather than link clicks, so enquiries land in the inbox where the front desk can convert them the same day.

Solution

Nine campaigns across wellness packages, braces, pregnancy care, home service and seasonal Ramadan and National Day offers. Reels carried reach, message ads carried conversion, and every line of copy was written to clear Meta's health-category policy on first review.

Real estate

Egypt & Oman · 3 campaigns · USD

Al-Abrar Real Estate

Property lead generation across two markets for a developer with twenty years in Oman.

277Qualified leads
$7.84Avg cost per lead
$5.66Best campaign CPL

Challenge

A long-established Omani developer moving into the Egyptian market. Two countries, two very different costs per lead, and a brand that needed to feel established in one market while being introduced in the other.

Strategy

Separate campaign structures per market rather than one blended account, so budgets could not cannibalise each other. Lead forms for enquiry volume; engagement campaigns around national moments to build brand equity cheaply.

Solution

Three campaigns: an Egypt-market lead generation push, a dedicated Hay Al Wafaa campaign in Sultan Haitham City running instant forms across a four-part creative sequence, and an Oman National Day engagement campaign that earned 28,653 post engagements for under a hundred dollars.

Real estate investment

Egypt · 6 campaigns · EGP

Invest House

Restructuring the account cut cost per enquiry by 63%, with the same creative running.

208Messaging conversations
EGP 18.48Best cost per conversation
63%Reduction vs. baseline

Challenge

An investment-focused developer whose ads read like every other listing in the feed. Cost per enquiry had settled above EGP 50, which made the channel hard to justify at scale.

Strategy

Reposition the messaging around the investment promise rather than the unit specification. Then split campaigns by project and unit type, move conversations into Messenger and WhatsApp where intent is higher, and treat the account structure itself as something to test.

Solution

Six campaigns spanning villas, apartments and multi-unit projects, including a call-ads campaign for buyers who prefer the phone. The rebuilt villa campaign landed conversations at EGP 18.48 against a baseline above EGP 50.

Full results

  • Calls placed9
  • Best cost per conversationEGP 18.48
  • Reduction vs. baseline63%
  • People reached30.7K

  • Messenger Ads

  • Call Ads
Education

Kuwait · 4 campaigns · EGP · Site & ads

Nerds Academy

I built the website and ran the campaigns that fill it. Moving enquiries to WhatsApp nearly halved the cost of each one.

58Enrolment conversations
EGP 135.68Best cost per conversation
48%Reduction vs. previous

Client

A Kuwait-based, ICEF-accredited study abroad agency placing students into UK universities. The campaigns are managed from Egypt, which is why the ad account bills in EGP while the audience sits in Kuwait.

Challenge

Enquiry demand concentrated around university intake dates, with cost per enquiry sitting above EGP 250. For a considered, high-value decision like studying abroad, that number had to come down before the channel could scale.

Strategy

Test the conversion channel itself. Move enquiries out of in-app messaging and into WhatsApp, where students and parents in the Gulf already talk, and keep the Instagram profile warm between intakes with a low-cost traffic campaign.

Solution

Four campaigns across two intakes. The WhatsApp campaign brought cost per conversation down to EGP 135.68 from EGP 261.25, and became the default structure for the account. A parallel traffic campaign delivered 184 Instagram profile visits at EGP 3.78 each.

The destination

I also built the site the campaigns drive to: eight static pages covering UK study routes, partner universities, English courses and agency services, with a consultation form at the end of every path. Because I run both, the ad and the page it lands on make the same promise.

Visit nerds-academy.net

    How the work gets done
